newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak sees cabinet reshuffle - paper.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak sees cabinet reshuffle - paper.

text.p: Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak said in remarks published on Saturday that a cabinet reshuffle was coming but candidates would be chosen carefully to ensure a smooth succession.

"As for the expected ministerial reshuffling, the president indicated that the changes were in the offing but they must be clearly defined and precisely chosen," said the statement in Al-Gomhuria newspaper.
"It's not possible that I appoint a minister and then discover after a couple of months that he is not suitable. Stability is key," Mubarak's statement said.
There was no indication which posts might be considered.
Egypt's public works and water resources portfolio has not been reassigned since former minister Abdel-Hadi Radi died last November.
